text: Visible CLI regressions require top-level `og --help` to print the global usage contract, `--non-interactive`, and core-command guidance; command-specific help for `init`, `sync`, `verify`, `replay`, `status`, `export`, `clean`, `explain`, `drift`, `mcp-server`, `optimize`, `optimize prompts`, `autopilot`, `autopilot init`, `autopilot disable`, `daemon`, `daemon install`, `daemon start`, `daemon stop`, `daemon status`, `daemon run`, `schema`, and `describe` to include usage, accepted options, output modes, and exit codes; `og --strict --json schema` and `og --json schema` to return an `ok` envelope for the `schema` command; and the visible portion of the schema-introspection test to confirm that `schema`, `describe`, `sync`, `daemon status`, `optimize prompts`, `verify`, `replay`, `explain`, and `mcp-server` signatures expose usage, request, response, known error code, and envelope-schema metadata plus request-field coverage for `--params`, `--strict`, `--output`, `--fields`, `--limit`, and `--offset`.
